Class AccountCredentialsValidator

java.lang.Object
app.order.validation.impl.AccountCredentialsValidator
All Implemented Interfaces:
OrderValidator
@Component public class AccountCredentialsValidator extends Object implements OrderValidator
Rejects trading by a profile whose credential record no longer exists.
